messages:
alex: Huge win — VentureBridge just signed a co-sell ISV partnership and published an initial listing in the marketplace. They also converted their private pilot to a Dedicated deployment in 4 weeks. Big props to Partnerships + Solutions! :tada:

marta: Amazing news! They ran end-to-end validation yesterday. After switching to Dedicated and enabling KV caching their median latency dropped ~22% and token cost per request is down ~18%.

jon: Sales update — they committed to a 12-month reserved capacity agreement, paperwork in progress, expected close next Monday. Reps on the deal: @jon, @marta.

sam (Solutions Eng): Onboarding checklist complete. Applied quant profile `q4_8` and tuned batching window for chat flows. Key command used: `rbw deploy --org venturebridge --config dedicated-prod.yaml`. Console link: https://console.redwood/integrations/venturebridge

devops-bot: Deployment succeeded — 3 GPU nodes (dedicated pool), autoscale policy `burst-low-latency` active. Trace id: trace_8c7f.

priya: Marketing planning a short case study + joint blog. Need a one-paragraph quote from their CTO and permission to use logos. @marta can you coordinate the assets and timeline? We're targeting an announcement after GA in ~2 weeks.

marta: On it. They also agreed to a joint webinar focused on ML Ops for regulated customers — tentative date Apr 7. I'll collect before/after metric snapshots (p50, p95, cost/token) for the case study.

alex: Huge thanks to everyone — shoutout to @sam for the rapid tuning and @eng-runtime for the kernel optimizations that helped the p95. :rocket:

marta: Quick note for docs: I'll create a short integration guide (marketplace -> dedicated migration steps) and a checklist for Solutions Eng to reuse on future ISV pilots.

jon: Adding a renewal reminder to CRM for month 11 and tagging this as a reference play for future co-sell motions.

priya: Love it — will draft the blog outline and share with the group by EOD tomorrow. :memo:
